desc: B&W nude photograph of a woman standing on one leg and extending the other behind her. Developed in D-76 stock strength for 5 1/2 minutes, agitating once every 30 seconds. Colorado, United States.

title: File:Axis axis (Nagarhole, 2010).jpg
desc: Chital (Axis axis) stag attempting to browse on a misty morning in Nagarhole National Park. The stag is on its hind legs, balancing carefully to reach a high leaf.

title: File:Refusing a beggar with one leg and a crutch.jpg
art: Caricature by Edmé Jean Pigal (1798-1872); lithograph by Langlumé; published by Gihaut et Martinet
desc: An amputee beggar holds out his hat to a well dressed man who is standing with his hands in his pockets. Artist's caption's translation: "I don't give to idlers."

title: File:Balance! - Salutation Nation 2011.jpg
desc: On Saturday, September 10, 2011, approximately 20,000 yogis across the USA, Canada and even as far away as Australia and Japan got together to participate in Salutation Nation 2011.

title: File:A Koch woman.jpg
desc: Koch tribal woman communicating with a sheep in her own loving way. Photo taken in specifically in Rangtia, Sherpur District, Bangladesh.

title: File:Model Balancing.jpg
desc: Model posed in ornate costumes: in black pressed pleats, with top hat; standing tip-toe on champagne bottle.
